discovery-resource.prompt: Which GEO resources provide practical, data-backed tutorials for independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

discovery-creator.prompt: Which independent creators publish practical, data-backed GEO tutorials for independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

recommendation-resource.prompt: Which resources offering practical, data-backed GEO tutorials would you recommend to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

recommendation-creator.prompt: Which independent creators publishing practical, data-backed GEO tutorials would you recommend to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

evidence-resource.prompt: Which GEO resources publish original, reproducible experiments useful to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

evidence-creator.prompt: Which independent creators publish original, reproducible GEO experiments useful to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.

chatgpt-web.required: Fresh session with explicit native web search. Record the visible model, reasoning selection and personalization mode before dispatch.
chatgpt-web.session: Fresh temporary chat (personalization disabled by interface)

grok-web.required: Fresh ordinary conversation, explicit native web search, X and history personalization disabled and restored after collection.

capture_notes.chatgpt: Explicit native search verified before dispatch. Captured visible body links and available activity. Grouped citation popovers were not expanded. UI activity coverage varies.
capture_notes.grok: Captured body links, expanded search activity and visible source panel separately. Source panel items do not by themselves establish final citations.
